lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official docs list the Ethereum Marketplace yzSyrup deployment and current product/security updates. Exact explorer displays user deposits on Oct 20/14 and operator fill on Oct 22, 2026; this is third-party indexed activity evidence, not a DAU/MAU count or fresh RPC proof. Search hit for help.meetyuzu.com shutdown concerns a separate dating application and is not evidence about Yuzu Money. No retirement/shutdown notice for this reviewed deployment encountered in reviewed sources.

marketEvidence.name: Yuzu Money
marketEvidence.scope: Whole-protocol TVL and Ethereum chain total, NOT yzSyrup vault TVL; DAU/MAU unverified.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Marketplace table attributes exact chain/address; exact-address explorer reports applicable implementation. Sourcify proxyResolution=false contradicts its TransparentUpgradeableProxy ABI/compilation and is NOT trusted as a no-proxy claim. Initial constructor logic differs from applicable explorer report.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full applicable implementation ABI retained unchanged; selected ABI fragments copied exactly, not generic ERC4626.

facetEvidence.evidence: Implementation constructor fixes this immutable facet; delegatecall forwards exact entrypoint calldata, with no caller-selected executor or opaque arbitrary call payload. Reviewed facet and shared base bodies for deposits, orders, role checks and fixed self-callbacks. No standalone facet/callback capability admitted.

sourceSemantics.entry: Deposit/mint calculate fee-net shares, enforce receiver roles/throttles and credit pool accounting, then callback to proxy for USDC transfer/mint. Underlying is initialized USDC. Pool valuation, fees and distribution are governed, not guaranteed redemption backing.
sourceSemantics.exit: YuzuILPV2.canRedeem always false -> YuzuProtoV2.maxWithdraw/maxRedeem zero; direct positive exits and slippage wrappers excluded. Six selected methods include both order creation variants, cancel and finalize. fillRedeemOrder is operator-only; assets are transferred from operator to vault after burning locked shares; finalize pays fixed receiver.
sourceSemantics.orders: Owner share allowance needed when controller != owner; dueTime=createdAt+configured fillWindow. Only pending orders may cancel, ordinary owner/controller only after dueTime and while unpaused; filler bypass is contract role authority, not catalog grant. Only Filled orders may finalize by owner/controller while unpaused. Order fee snapshotted at creation; asset price selected at fill; no minimum output or deadline. No claim of fixed 3-day live configuration.

selectedFunctions.label: Cancel a due pending yzSyrup redemption
warnings: Ethereum yzSyrup Marketplace vault only, not bridged syzUSD, yzUSD issuer or yzPrime. Proxy constructor initialized USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48; assets use USDC base units and shares use vault decimals. Deposits require caller USDC allowance to the proxy and can route funds to its configured treasury and fee receiver.

Upgradeable TransparentUpgradeableProxy: explorer-reported YuzuILPV3 implementation 0x577C202011Dd122Bcb0ad1bf4a71e01E9F999b68 binds a constructor-fixed facet 0x19fa50cc96dc461fc16fc2a4a644188e1aa4a2de. Source-service proxyResolution incorrectly reports isProxy=false despite its proxy ABI; binding uses the exact proxy explorer report. Implementation/facet source-service labels are match, not exact_match. No fresh storage, bytecode, configured dependency or upgrade-persistence attestation.

Deposit/mint obey pause, pool-update, mint restrictions, receiver role, minimum deposit, supply cap, block/day throttle, zero-supply reconciliation and fee-eroded accounting gates. Fees, pool NAV, distributions and integer rounding change exchange rates; small deposits may mint zero shares. These entrypoints have no caller-set minimum shares, maximum assets or deadline.

Positive direct withdraw/redeem and their slippage variants are unavailable in this implementation: inherited canRedeem always returns false, so they are not admitted. Exits require createRedeemOrder, an external ORDER_FILLER_ROLE holder filling and funding the order, then finalizeRedeemOrder; no settlement deadline or liquidity guarantee is supplied by this catalog.

Redeem order locks owner shares, spends allowance for delegated creation, fixes receiver/controller and snapshots order fee. It is priced at fill rather than request; max-fee variant bounds fee ppm only, not final asset output. Owner/controller may finalize a filled order; owner/controller cancellation requires a pending order, unpaused state and its dueTime. Operator may cancel earlier or during pause. Finalization sends USDC to the recorded receiver.

Operator fill and administrative/role, pool valuation, fee, treasury, burn, permit, token-transfer and router-self-callback methods are excluded. Configurable restriction flags and roles may gate participation even though current public Marketplace docs describe permissionless access. Catalog admission neither grants these roles nor establishes legal eligibility, yield, backing, liquidity, complete workflows, execution success or financial safety. All admitted calls are nonpayable and retain independent grants, pauses and canonical-value/calldata controls.

It is priced at fill rather than request; max-fee variant bounds fee ppm only, not final asset output. Owner/controller may finalize a filled order; owner/controller cancellation requires a pending order, unpaused state and its dueTime. Operator may cancel earlier or during pause. Finalization sends USDC to the recorded receiver.

Operator fill and administrative/role, pool valuation, fee, treasury, burn, permit, token-transfer and router-self-callback methods are excluded. Configurable restriction flags and roles may gate participation even though current public Marketplace docs describe permissionless access. Catalog admission neither grants these roles nor establishes legal eligibility, yield, backing, liquidity, complete workflows, execution success or financial safety. All admitted calls are nonpayable and retain independent grants, pauses and canonical-value/calldata controls.
